Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Content Marketing Strategist position at your company. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and content creation, I am confident that my skills and experience align well with the requirements of this role.

In my current position as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained comprehensive experience in content marketing. I own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and write keyword-targeted blog content that drives organic traffic. I also build and maintain client websites in WordPress using Elementor and the Astra theme, ensuring cohesive messaging and optimal user experience. My work with analytics tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs allows me to analyze content performance and make data-driven adjustments.

My personal project, mirook.com, demonstrates my ability to develop and implement content strategies. I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site, implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema) and entity optimization, and ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project has honed my skills in content optimization, storytelling, and project management.

I am particularly drawn to this role because it combines creativity with strategic thinking. I enjoy researching content trends and competitor activities to craft compelling narratives that engage audiences. My collaborative mindset and excellent communication skills enable me to work effectively with SEO, design, and development teams.

I am eager to bring my expertise in content marketing, SEO, and analytics to your team and contribute to your business objectives. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can add value to your organization.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
